decisions.reason: The drawing-format request does not change layout conventions; the separate color-presentation clause already has its own same-message MODIFY.

The candidate already requires IPT as preferred and STEP as the minimum acceptable 3D format. The source repeats that preference without changing the candidate state, while IDW concerns editable drawings.
The requested DWG, DXF, and IDW deliverable formats do not alter dimension-annotation accuracy, and the unspecified minor corrections do not entail a concrete state change.
Changing requested drawing deliverable formats does not alter the bushing or piston-rod guidance arrangement.
Changing requested drawing deliverable formats does not alter the welded-lug geometry, fabrication sequence, angular spacing, or face finishing.
